result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors. The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()`:

**`codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java:747`**: `if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email))`

- Configured teams are unchanged. Their members are added before this check, so dormant members stay in their teams.
- Blank latest-commit dates count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input. Nobody is dropped for missing data.
- Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped entirely, so their repositories don't count toward the remainder either.

The codeanalyzer module's test suite passes offline: the surefire reports show no failures or errors. There was no existing test covering the landscape teams, so I did not add one. I did not commit.
